note: Indicative representative points for the seven demand sub-areas, placed at the approximate centre of each named neighbourhood. These are POINTS, not boundaries: the sub-areas have no digitised polygons here, and inventing them would imply a spatial precision the synthetic OD pattern does not have. Presentation only, exactly as link_geometry.json is -- no calculation reads these coordinates, and the burden values drawn at them come from the model's segment table, not from any geography. The Mississauga / west GTA point stands for a catchment reaching well beyond the marker, and is placed west of the screenline to show the direction demand arrives from rather than where those travellers live.
